Nadia Flores: Small UX bug on super-narrow widths (~300px): when the left rail auto-collapses the ID column reflows and keyboard focus sometimes disappears. iPhone SE repro. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.internal/ux/clip-900.png

Ethan Wu: Repro'd. Cause looks like the sidebar width transition + long ID strings. Quick fix idea: clamp() the ID column and add an inline copy icon so users don't need a popover.

Rosa Mendes: Accessibility: make sure the copy button has aria-label with full text and announce copy to an aria-live region. Also don't remove all transitions for those who prefer reduced motion.

Ethan Wu: POC CSS I'll try: ```css
.id-cell{ min-width:88px; max-width:clamp(72px,28vw,160px); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.main{ contain:layout; }
.sidebar--anim{ transition: none; }
```
I'll push a tiny change to staging and include visual diffs at 320px.

Build-Bot: Staging build 511 deployed to staging-ux: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/511 :rocket:

Nadia Flores: Assigning @Ethan to land the CSS and inline copy, @Rosa for a11y review. If green, promote to canary tomorrow. Thanks!
